runSummary.note: Real 17 Sep 01:02 sweep. Ten independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities, and public Facebook indexing. No promotion-grade new job was found. Upwork returned a WooCommerce product-listing project at $10-30/h, worldwide remote, but it is already three weeks old, has 20-50 proposals, one hire and four interviews. A WordPress developer role posted yesterday pays $30-60/h but requires native English, US business hours and PHP/HTML/CSS/client-facing development, so it is a strong mismatch. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Proposal-age opportunity decay
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Combine listing age, proposal band, hires and active interviews into one opportunity-decay score. Demote older freelance jobs aggressively when hiring has already started, even when the skill fit and nominal hourly rate remain attractive.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Work-hours/timezone hardness
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Parse mandatory working-hour overlap separately from generic remote status. Remote jobs requiring fixed US or other distant business hours should carry a schedule burden penalty or hard rejection when the shift materially conflicts with the preferred daytime Slovakia routine.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data, job-sources or MASTER is attempted where full round-trip content cannot be guaranteed.
